Built to Showcase, Cooled to Perform
Elite 681
The Elite 681 redefines showcase builds with its panoramic 270° tempered glass panels and true dual-chamber layout. Designed for high performance systems, it combines refined aesthetics with cutting-edge airflow engineering. From vertical cooling support to extensive radiator compatibility, this case is built to handle next-gen hardware with style and precision.
270° Seamless Glass Design
Dual tempered glass panels with 45° bevels offer an uninterrupted, ultra-clean view of your system and lighting.
True Dual-Chamber Layout
Separate chambers for motherboard and PSU/cabling streamline airflow and simplify cable management with 95mm clearance.
Extreme Cooling Compatibility
Supports dual 360mm radiators (top & bottom) and one 280mm side radiator for custom loops or powerful AIOs.
Vertical Airflow Configuration
Up to 10 fans with bottom-to-top layout accelerate heat dissipation for superior thermal performance.
Pre-installed ARGB Fans with Sync
Includes 4 ARGB fans (3 reverse intake + 1 exhaust) with daisy-chaining and full motherboard lighting sync.
Full Mesh Ventilation
Large mesh panels on the top and bottom provide maximum airflow for efficient cooling.
RTX 50 Series Ready
Supports GPUs up to 410mm, perfect for the latest next-gen graphics cards.
Next-Gen High-Speed I/O
Features USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 Type-C (20Gbps) and dual USB 3.0 ports for fast and flexible connectivity.
